mathematical_definition: hurst_120 - 0.5 -- a signed recentering of the base feature set's rolling Hurst exponent so positive values indicate trend-persistence (H>0.5) and negative values indicate mean-reversion (H<0.5)

missing_value_policy: NaN whenever the base hurst_120 feature is NaN (first 120 bars, or a degenerate near-constant window), never zero-filled
